reason: The Recipient combobox exposes invalid=true and errormessage "Please choose a recipient." in the accessibility tree, so the error is programmatically tied to the field. axe objects only that the message element is not a live region, aria-describedby target or alert, which weakens how well some screen readers read it when the field is focused. The failure to announce the error when it appears is the separate status-message finding.

value.name: Recipient
value.template: combobox "Recipient" [expanded=false, haspopup=listbox, invalid=true, errormessage=Please choose a recipient.]

reason: Reproduced by keyboard: Enter on Next shows "Please choose a recipient.", disables Next and drops focus to the page body. The message span has no live-region or alert ancestor and no live region changed, so a screen-reader user hears nothing and Next just goes dead. The task stays possible once they find the field, so medium; this is a form error, not the confirmation of a money movement.
